The youth-serving arm of the OCWB, YES, home of the MYA,
was established in 2010 to develop Richmond's future
leaders and workforce. YES is a comprehensive program

through work-based learning and youth development. It
offers job readiness training, leadership development,
entrepreneurship opportunities, mentoring, and exposure to
post-secondary education and career exploration options.

The Summer 2024 Work-Based Learning Program
achieved unprecedented success, with over 500 youth
aged 14-24 participating in diverse work-based learning
experiences, marking a pivotal moment in the program's
14-year history.

logged over 13,000 work hours across various sectors,
enhancing their soft skills, confidence, time management,
